final_message:
Yen receipts now show `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

The cause is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, which is wrong for yen because yen has no minor unit. That file is outside the payments scope, so I left it alone. I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead, where JPY amounts are now formatted as whole units. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`.

The same bug will still show up in invoices, cart and admin, which also call `formatMoney`. The better fix is in `formatMoney` itself, so you may want to pass that on to the team that owns `src/utils/money.js`.
